entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I need to start a return for an order. It's for a pair of cycling shoes I bought a while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Got it. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Clip cycling shoes, delivered about 80 days ago. Can I ask what the specific issue was with them?
They just weren't a good fit for my feet. I tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, but no matter what I did, I kept getting terrible blisters on my heels after every ride.
I'm sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check our policy for you.
Thanks. I'm just hoping to get a refund.
Okay, I've just reviewed the return eligibility. Since the purchase was made 80 days ago, it falls well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you.
Oh, that's great news. So I'll get a full refund?
Yes, that's correct. A full refund to your original payment method once we receive the item. I'm emailing you the prepaid return label right now. You should see it in your inbox shortly.

Perfect. Now, since I had such a poor experience with the blisters and I'm still in the market for some gear, would it be possible to also get a small discount code for a future purchase? Maybe 10% for the trouble?

I understand the request, and I'm glad we could get the return sorted out for you. Our policy allows for a full refund in this situation, but I'm not authorized to provide an additional discount on top of that. The refund is the primary solution we offer when a product doesn't work out.
Alright, I thought it was worth asking. I appreciate you processing the return so easily. I'll get these shoes shipped back this week.
You're very welcome. Once we get them back, your refund will be processed in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all. Thanks for your help, David.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
